description: Names, in order, of the checks every LocationRepository + BoxRepository + NamedProductRepository implementation must pass (RepositoryContract on each platform). Each platform asserts that its own contract check names equal this list, so the two contracts cannot drift.

cases.name: a new store has no locations and no default
locations are returned by sortOrder then name
ensureDefault creates the default once and is idempotent
ensureDefault creates a default next to existing non-default locations
a second default location is rejected
inserting a known location id is rejected
a box round-trips with a day-precise expiry
month precision and unknown expiry round-trip distinctly
markRemoved hides a box from activeBoxes but keeps the record
undoRemoval restores a removed box
update changes fields, bumps updatedAt, keeps createdAt and removal
operations on an unknown box throw notFound
a box in an unknown location or with a known id is rejected
a deleted box disappears from every query
undoDelete restores a deleted box
delete and undoDelete on unknown or wrong-state boxes throw notFound
a second box with the same gtin and serial is rejected with duplicateSerial
a deleted box frees its serial
box by gtin and serial returns removed boxes but not deleted ones
latestBox returns the most recent non-deleted box of a gtin
update to a serial already in the cabinet is rejected
undoDelete is rejected when the serial was taken meanwhile
cabinetBoxes returns only boxes in the cabinet with that gtin, oldest first
deleted locations disappear from all and defaultLocation
create places a location last and rejects a normalized duplicate name
rename rejects a duplicate name and allows a case change of its own name
reorder sets sortOrder and rejects an incomplete id list
setDefault leaves exactly one default
the default location cannot be deleted
deleting a location with cabinet boxes needs a destination
delete moving boxes moves only boxes in the cabinet and tombstones the location
undoDelete restores an empty deleted location unless its name was taken
boxes cannot be inserted into or moved to a deleted location
observeCabinet emits after each write and excludes removed and deleted boxes
observeAll emits after location changes
named products: remember creates the live named product of a gtin
named products: remember with equal values does not write
named products: remember updates the name, category and flag of the live product
named products: at most one live named product per gtin
named products: rename renames the product and every box with its gtin that is not deleted
named products: setCategory sets the category and flag of the product and of those boxes
named products: rename and setCategory throw notFound for an unknown or forgotten product
named products: forget hides the product and keeps its boxes
named products: undoForget restores the product as it was
named products: undoForget refuses when the gtin was named again
named products: forget and undoForget throw notFound when there is nothing to forget or restore
named products: summaries count only boxes in the cabinet and order by normalized name then gtin
named products: observeSummaries emits after a named product or a box changes
named products: a new store has a pending backfill and completeBackfill clears it
named products: completeBackfill keeps a live product that appeared meanwhile
boxes: latestBoxPerGTIN returns the newest non-deleted box of every gtin
